uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_material_preflight.py tests/test_agent_tools_hard_edges.py tests/test_agent_tools_assets.py tests/test_agent_tools_material.py tests/test_agent_tools_views.py tests/test_agent_tools_state.py -q

describe.command: uv run --no-sync reseam tools describe material.preflight

output.name: material.preflight
output.description: Read-only normal/UV, atlas and finite Blender ray diagnostics.

request.snapshot: required snapshot.json path or snapshot directory
request.source_snapshot: optional same-index enriched normal evidence snapshot
request.high_snapshot: required for projection; imported world-space geometry; high_state_hash optionally pins it
request.cage_snapshot: optional same-index snapshot with metadata.cage_for_state_hash equal to low state_hash; cage_state_hash optionally pins it
request.projection: {front_fraction:.02,back_fraction:.02,timeout_seconds:240}; normalized by LOW bounding-box diagonal; 16 deterministic samples/face
request.part_pairings: optional [{low_faces:[ids],high_objects:[names]}]; names from high snapshot objects; remaining low faces query all high geometry
request.views: true; existing error/seam view and orthographic ray overlay
request.note: preflight.json/report.md; pass/warn/fail/not_checked separate from execution and final quality; no edits/acceptance; single active 0-1 atlas only

output.contract: New output directory only. Execution status is separate from quality acceptance.

run.command: uv run --no-sync reseam tools run material.preflight --request artifacts/normal-preflight/examples05/toolbox_high_check_request.json --output artifacts/normal-preflight/cli_smoke01
